source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The donation-tab integration task registers TabOpen before triggering the notification, obtains tabInfo from that event, then waits for example.com/ and checks that same tabInfo.browser.currentURI.spec. This ties the assertion to the opened tab rather than whichever tab is currently selected. Preserve URL normalization in the awaited/asserted value. The landing adds a separate unit fallback task for missing tabmail; this browser assertion does not cover that branch. Source and historical review reconciliation only; no test ran.
title: Bind notification-tab waits and URI assertions to the tab returned by TabOpen
